summary: Dittofeed is an open-source platform for customer engagement and messaging automation, operating as a self-hosted alternative to tools like Braze or Customer.io. It helps teams orchestrate multi-channel communications and automated message flows for their user base. The project is distributed under an MIT licence and containerised for straightforward deployment.
goodFor: It suits technical teams wanting to run their own marketing automation and user messaging infrastructure without relying on proprietary cloud services.
watchOut: The codebase has a moderate maintenance tempo and relies on a feature set that directly competes with established, highly polished commercial platforms.
deployNotes: Because it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage, set up environment variables for external services, and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
